title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Joshua 11: the northern kings at the waters of Merom, the burning of Hazor, and the end of the Anakim.

questions.text: Who sent to Jobab king of Madon and to the other kings at the start of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Jabin king of Hazor heard of it and sent to Jobab king of Madon and to the other kings.

questions.text: To what is the size of the kings' armies compared?
questions.explanation: They went out with many people, even as the sand on the seashore in multitude, with very many horses and chariots.

questions.text: Where did all these kings encamp together to fight Israel?
questions.explanation: All these kings met together and encamped at the waters of Merom to fight with Israel.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Joshua to do to the enemies' horses?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Joshua to hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.

questions.text: What does the text say Hazor used to be?
questions.explanation: Joshua took Hazor and struck its king, for Hazor used to be the head of all those kingdoms.

answers.text: The head of all those kingdoms

questions.text: What did the children of Israel take for themselves from these cities?
questions.explanation: The children of Israel took all the plunder of these cities, with the livestock, as plunder for themselves.

answers.text: Only silver and gold for Yahweh's treasury
All the plunder, with the livestock

questions.text: How did Joshua carry out what Yahweh had commanded Moses?
questions.explanation: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua, and Joshua left nothing undone of all that Yahweh commanded.

answers.text: He did only half of it
He left it for the elders

questions.text: Which people were the only ones to make peace with the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: Not a city made peace with Israel except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon.

answers.text: The Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem
The Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon
The Canaanites, the people of Hazor
The Amorites, the people of Madon

questions.text: Which people did Joshua cut off from Hebron, Debir, Anab, and the hill country?
questions.explanation: Joshua cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, Debir, and Anab, and destroyed them with their cities.

questions.text: In which cities did some of the Anakim remain?
questions.explanation: None of the Anakim were left in Israel's land; only in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod did some remain.
